subject: Orion Summit — Sponsor fulfillment & ops playbook
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@orion-summits.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor fulfillment draft + stage demo slot

Hi Diego —

Thanks again for committing to the Orion Summit sponsor package. Attached is our updated fulfillment matrix (v3) with timing windows for logo placement, on-site deliverables, and the 20-minute stage demo slot we tentatively reserved for Redwood. Key callouts: 

- Stage demo: Friday 11:00–11:20 (main hall). AV includes single laptop HDMI, lapel mic, and 2 practice slots on Thursday stage run-through.
- Logo placement: main stage backdrop + partner page (size medium) + mobile app hero rotation on event day.
- 500 guaranteed pre-registered attendees in your vertical tracks; lead retrieval via QR badge scan (vendor: LeadCollect).
- Two exhibitor badges + one speaker badge included. Additional staff passes available at discounted rate.
- Shipping deadline for booth materials: Oct 20 (arrive-by to show warehouse).

I attached the fulfillment matrix and AI logo specs for final approval. We can incorporate one minor SOW change (we can add a dedicated practice run instead of just walk-through). If that works, I will push the SOW to DocuSign this afternoon.

Attachments: sponsor_fulfillment_matrix_v3.pdf, logo_specs_AI.zip

Would love confirmation by EOD tomorrow so our production team can lock the backdrop art.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Partnerships Lead | Orion Summits
alyssa@orion-summits.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Alyssa —

Thanks for the matrix, looks good overall. A few quick clarifying items before we sign: 

1) Stage demo logistics: can you confirm whether audience Q&A is included in the 20 minutes or if we get 5 extra for Q&A? We need to know to plan the live demo flow.
2) Lead retrieval: can Redwood get raw lead export (CSV) within 24 hours post-event? We may want an immediate follow-up flow.
3) Branding placement: medium size on partner page is fine, but can we guarantee our logo is on the main event countdown email (send to registrants 48 hours before event)? That is high-value for us.
4) Shipping: our booth includes a demo rack that requires a hand-carry to stage. Do you provide in-hall labor for install during exhibitor move-in?

If those are feasible we can sign. Copying Evelyn and Marcus to confirm production and speaker logistics on our side.

Diego

Hi Diego —

Great questions, answers below: 

1) Yes, the 20-minute slot is configurable: 15 minutes presentation + 5 minutes live Q&A. If you need 25 minutes total that would be a premium add-on (we can discuss).
2) We will provide a full raw lead export (CSV) within 24 hours; we also offer live lead syncing into HubSpot as an add-on.
3) We can include Redwood in the 48-hour countdown email as a featured partner banner (confirmed).
4) We supply one in-hall labor pass per exhibitor (hand-carry + light install). If you need crate handling or rigging for the demo rack there will be a labor fee; please indicate whether you plan to crate it.

I updated the fulfillment matrix to reflect the countdown email and the 24-hour lead export. See attached matrix v3 (revised). If you confirm the in-hall labor scope we will route the SOW to DocuSign.

Attachments: sponsor_fulfillment_matrix_v3.pdf (revised)

Best,
Alyssa

Team — forwarding the updated matrix from Orion. Quick ops checklist I want us to confirm before I sign: 

- Speaker flow: we should plan a 15+5 format. Marcus, can you draft a 7-step demo run script and a one-slide failover fallback? Who will be our on-stage MC?
- AV check: request HDMI + clicker + lapel. Marcus, confirm laptop image scaling with stagemanager; we should bring a backup USB-C dongle.
- Logistics: Evelyn, confirm crate vs hand-carry. If crate, get estimate for crate handling fee (Orion says charged separately). Shipping deadline Oct 20.
- Lead flow: we will take raw CSV + explore HubSpot sync post-event. Aditya, please confirm if SalesOps can accept a CSV import and map fields for immediate follow-up within 24 hours.
- Collateral: need a one-page summary (leave-behind) and two demo units labeled.

Can we have Marcus + Evelyn confirm by COB today so I can push this to Alyssa? Also we should flag any on-site labor fees before signing.

Diego
